newsitem.title: USA: Max & Erma's sees Q1 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Max & Erma's sees Q1 earnings below estimates.

text.p: Max & Erma's Restaurants Inc on Monday said its fiscal first-quarter earnings would fall below analyst forecasts.

The company expects earnings to range between $0.12 and $0.13 a share in the quarter ended February 16, versus $0.10 cents per share in the comparable period a year earlier. It said recent analyst estimates for the quarter have ranged between $0.14 and $0.17 per share.

The earnings shortfall is expected even though the company sees revenues rising to between $26 million and $27 million, about 20 percent more than the $23.1 million reported in the year-earlier period.
The company said a tight labor supply, which has affected the restaurant industry for the last two years, was the primary reason for the expected shortfall.
It added that compensation and benefits costs have increased, and that margins and earnings were also affected by a higher cost of sales.
Max & Erma's operates about 40 casual-dining restaurants.
